topic: Turning On Electricity and Water Before Moving In

script.title: TURNING ON THE LIGHTS
script.scene_zh: 水電賬務專線 · 開通水電
script.story_hook: Nine days to move-in, and the taps sleep.
script.intro_zh: 九日後就要搬家，水龍頭還在沉睡。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's call turns on a new home. Listen for utility words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天這通電話要為新家開通水電。留意實用的賬務說法。
script.outro: And that's a bright first evening ahead. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一個明亮的夜晚就在前頭。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her early thirties with wavy chestnut hair in a loose side braid, a denim work jacket over an orange flannel shirt, freckles, and a lean athletic build
script.char_b_description: a bald man in his fifties with a thick reddish-brown beard, wire rimmed safety glasses, a high visibility yellow vest over a blue plaid shirt, steel toe boots, and a broad build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm calling to turn on power and water.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈkɔlɪŋ tə tɜn ɑn ˈpaʊɚ ænd ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我打電話來開通這一戶的電和水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you found the new tenants desk. Name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ju faʊnd ðə nu ˈtɛnənts dɛsk neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你找到了新住戶專線。請問大名？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nadia Okafor. Unit 4B, the Maple Street duplex.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɑdiə ɑˈkɔfɚ ˈjut ˈfɔɹi bi ðə ˈmeɪpəl stɹit duˌplɛks/
dialogue.zh: 娜迪雅·歐卡弗，楓樹街雙併屋的 4B 戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Nadia. When's your move-in day?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mit ju ˈnɑdiə wɛnz jɔɹ muːvˈɪn deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，娜迪雅。你幾號搬家？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First of October, so nine days from today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst ɑv ɑkˈtoʊbɚ soʊ naɪn deɪz fɹəm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 十月一號，所以還有九天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great timing. Electricity and water both, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ɪˌlɛkˈtɹɪsəɾi ænd ˈwɔɾɚ boʊ ɪz ðæt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 時間真剛巧。電和水都要開通，對不對？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both, yes, plus I hope the gas later.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊ jɛs plʌs aɪ hoʊp ðə ɡæs ˈleɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個都要，還有，之後可能也想開天然氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gas comes after, let's start with lights first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡæs kʌmz ˈæfɚ lɛts stɑɹt wɪð laɪts fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 天然氣之後再說，我們先讓燈亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds like a plan, um, what do you need?
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz laɪk ə plæn ʌm wət du ju nid/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒。嗯，需要我提供什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your lease start date and a photo ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ lis stɑɹt deɪt ænd ə ˈfoʊˌtoʊ aɪˈdi/
dialogue.zh: 你的租約起始日，和一張附照片的身份證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can text my lease, or email a scan.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn tɛkst maɪ lis ɔɹ ˈimeɪl ə skæn/
dialogue.zh: 我可以傳租約簡訊，或是用電子郵件發掃描檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email works, I'll send the confirmation address now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimeɪl wɜks aɪl sɛnd ðə kɑnˌfɜɹˈmeɪʃən əˈdɹɛs naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 郵件就好，我現在把收件地址傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, ping coming your way in a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt pɪŋ ˈkʌmɪŋ jɔɹ weɪ ɪn ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 收到，一分鐘內就發過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush. Now, the deposit question, ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ naʊ ðə dɪˈpɑzəʃən ˈkwɛstʃən ˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 不著急。接下來是押金的問題，準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Uh, is there a deposit? My budget whispers no.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ɪz ðɛɹ ə dɪˈpɑzəʃən maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt ˈwɪspɚz noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，請問有押金嗎？我的錢包已經在小聲抗議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, usually two months for new tenants, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈjuʒəwəli tu mʌnθs fɚ nu ˈtɛnənts ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，新住戶通常是兩個月，先說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two months... um, can my wallet appeal?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌnθs ʌm kæn maɪ ˈwɑlət əˈpil/
dialogue.zh: 兩個月⋯⋯嗯，我的小錢包還有申訴權嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually, a pay history waives it, ever paid bills?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli ə peɪ ˈhɪstəɹi weɪvz ɪt ˈɛvɚ peɪd bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 其實，繳費紀錄可以免押金，你以前按時繳過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back home, utilities? Paid them every single month.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk hoʊm juˈtɪlədz peɪd ðɛm ˈɛvɹi ˈsɪŋɡəl mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 在老家時，水電費我一向按時繳清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then one call to your old provider does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn kɑl tə jɔɹ oʊld pɚˈvaɪdɚ dʌz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那麼一通電話，請舊供應商開個證明就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, that sounds simple enough, who do I call?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðæt saʊndz ˈsɪmpəl ɪˈnʌf hu du aɪ kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 等等，聽起來很簡單，我該打給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They verify on file, no fee, about five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈvɛrəˌfaɪ ɑn faɪl noʊ fi əˈbaʊt faɪv ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 他們核對紀錄就行，不收費，大約五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done deal, I'll ring them right after this.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dil aɪl ɹɪŋ ðɛm ɹaɪt ˈæfɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 成交，掛了這通我就打過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Now, paper bills or the eco-friendly click?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt naʊ ˈpeɪpɚ bɪlz ɔɹ ði ˈikoʊˌfɹɛndli klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那賬單要紙本，還是環保的網路版？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click for me, paper feels like homework anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk fɚ mi ˈpeɪpɚ filz laɪk ˈhoʊmˌwɜɪk ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 網路版就好，紙本總讓我想到作業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Auto-pay too? It shaves one dollar monthly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɾoʊˌpeɪ tu ɪt ʃeɪvz wʌn ˈdɑləɹ ˈmʌnθli/
dialogue.zh: 自動扣款也要嗎？一個月能省一塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shaves? Well, the barber is welcome, sign me up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪvz wɛl ðə ˈbɑɹbɚ ɪz ˈwɛlkəm saɪn mi ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 也能刮？那這位理髮師我歡迎，幫我加上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, done, autopay from your checking account.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ dʌn ˈɔɾoʊpeɪ fɹəm jɔɹ ˈtʃɛkɪŋ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，加好了，從你的銀行活期戶自動扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One worry, um, what if the power stays dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈwɜɹi ʌm wət ɪf ðə ˈpaʊɚ steɪz dɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 還有一個擔心，嗯，到時候燈不亮怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we send a tech, no charge, same day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi sɛnd ə tɛʃ noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ seɪm deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們派人過去，不收費，當天處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No charge? America, you surprise me pleasantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ əˈmɛɹɪkə ju sɚˈpɹaɪz mi ˈplɛzəntli/
dialogue.zh: 不收費？美國，你給了我一個驚喜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have our moments. Water needs a valve check.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv ɑɹ ˈmoʊməntəz ˈwɔɾɚ nidz ə vælv tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 我們也有可愛的時候。不過水閥還得檢查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Valve check, that's outside, right, near the sidewalk?
dialogue.phonetic: /vælv tʃɛk ðæts ˈaʊtˌsaɪd ɹaɪt nɪɹ ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɑk/
dialogue.zh: 檢查水閥，就在外面，人行道旁邊那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, yellow box, we tap it Tuesday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈjeloʊ bɑks wi tæp ɪt ˈtɜɹzˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，那個黃色小箱子，我們星期二上午去開閥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday? I work Tuesdays, can I be home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɜɹzˌdeɪ aɪ wɜɹk ˈtɜɹzˌdeɪz kæn aɪ bi hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 星期二？我要上班，我可以在家等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Being home isn't needed, five minutes, that's all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbin hoʊm ˈɪzənt ˈnidəd faɪv ˈmɪnəts ðæts ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 不需要人在家，五分鐘就搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief again. My plants will thank the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlif əˈɡɛn maɪ plænts wɪl θæŋk ðə ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 又安心了。我的植物們會感謝這自來水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, tell me about it, my ferns are drama.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɛl mi əˈbaʊt ɪt maɪ fɜnz ɑɹ ˈdɹɑmə/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，說到植物，我家蕨類每天都在演大戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ferns! Okay, is the account number on the email?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜnz oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ði əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbɚ ɑn ði ˈimeɪl/
dialogue.zh: 蕨類！對了，帳號會寫在電子郵件裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in the welcome email, plus a login.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn ðə ˈwɛlkəm ˈimeɪl plʌs ə ˈlɑɡˌɪn/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎信裡就有，還附上一組登入密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. The lease ends June, so, cancel anytime?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðə lis ɛndz dʒun soʊ ˈkænsəl ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。租約六月到期，所以隨時能停？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cancel anytime, a week's notice by phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkænsəl ˈɛniˌtaɪm ə wiːks ˈnoʊɾəs baɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 隨時能停，打一通電話，提前一週就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, I hope we say that goodbye far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾəd aɪ hoʊp wi seɪ ðæt ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ fɑɹ əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，但希望那句再見，我們很久以後才說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far away is the goal. One last quick thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑɹ əˈweɪ ɪz ðə ɡoʊl wʌn læst kwɪk θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 很久以後正是目標。最後一件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it comes... what did I miss?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ɪt kʌmz wət dɪd aɪ mɪs/
dialogue.zh: 來了來了⋯⋯我又漏了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emergency line, save it now, before you forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈmɜɹdʒənsi laɪn seɪv ɪt naʊ bɪˈfɔɹ ju fɚˈɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 急修專線，現在就存起來，趁你還沒忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, caught me. Nine-one-one, or a local number?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kɑt mi naɪn wʌn wʌn ɔɹ ə ˈloʊkəl ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，說中我了。是 911，還是地方的電話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Local one, saved in the email, marked urgent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊkəl wʌn sævd ɪn ði ˈimeɪl mɑɹkt ˈɜɹdʒənt/
dialogue.zh: 地方的那支，存在郵件裡，標了急字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved it, twice, since my memory needs help.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd ɪt twaɪs sɪnz maɪ ˈmɛməɹi nidz hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 存好了，存兩份，我的記性需要幫手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wisest habit our new tenants ever build.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwaɪzdəst ˈhæbəɪt ɑʊɹ nu ˈtɛnənts ˈɛvɚ bɪld/
dialogue.zh: 這是我們新住戶最讚的好習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, that's it? Lights, water, deposits, all handled?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðæts ɪt laɪts ˈwɔɾɚ dɪˈpɑzəʃənz ɔl ˈhændəld/
dialogue.zh: 所以，就這樣？燈、水、押金，全搞定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All handled, October first, you'll flip a bright switch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈhændəld ɑkˈtoʊbɚ fɝst jul flɪp ə braɪt swɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 全搞定，十月一號，你就會按下明亮的開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That switch is mine to celebrate, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt swɪtʃ ɪz maɪn tə ˈsɛləˌbreɪt ˈpɹɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 那個開關我一定為它慶祝，說到做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Celebrate responsibly, with lights on, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛləˌbreɪt rɪˈspɑnsəbəli wɪð laɪts ɑn hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 慶祝歸慶祝，記得燈要開著，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Well, thank you for the patience today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɛl θæŋk ju fɚ ðə ˈpeɪʃəns təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！不管怎樣，謝謝你今天的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was fun, real talk, the fern chat helped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz fʌn ɹɪəl tɔk ðə fɜn tʃæt hɛlpt/
dialogue.zh: 過程很愉快，說真的，聊植物最療癒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, I'll introduce you to my peace lily.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪl ˌɪntrəˈdus ju tə maɪ pis ˈlɪli/
dialogue.zh: 下次我介紹我的白鶴芋給你認識。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, tell her I said hydrate, see you soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tɛl hɜɹ aɪ sɛd ˈhaɪˌdreɪt si ju sun/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，幫我告訴她要多喝水，再見啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Bye for now, utility friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl baɪ fɚ naʊ juˈtɪləɾə frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。先這樣囉，公用事業的好朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Nadia, enjoy that first bright evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈnɑdiə ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðæt fɝst braɪt ˈivəˌnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，娜迪雅，享受第一個明亮的夜晚。

script.youtube_title: 【新家入住前開通水電🔌】「我的錢包小聲說不」免押金・自動扣款・急修專線一次聊齊🚿💡📋｜聽完就會自己打電話｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Setting Up Utilities
script.youtube_title_en: "My Budget Whispers No" — Turning On Electricity and Water Before Moving In
script.youtube_description:
「我的錢包小聲說不」——搬家倒數九天，新家的燈和水還沉睡著，這通開通電話非打不可，押金卻聽起來像天文數字。

這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在新住戶服務專線的另一端。

你會聽到：報地址與租約起始日開始開戶；押金怎麼用過去的繳費紀錄申請豁免；紙本賬單與網路賬單的選法、自動扣款省一塊的小祕密；燈不亮時派人當天免費檢修、水閥箱星期二早上開閥；還有停用的通知規則與急修專線該存哪一支。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，反覆出現的是美國人講電話的真實語感：um、well、so、ha。聽完你就會用：I'm calling to turn on...、is there a deposit?、Auto-pay too?、Cancel anytime。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

script.youtube_description_en:
"My budget whispers no" — moving day is nine days away, the new place has sleeping taps and dark lamps, and the deposit number sounds like a mountain.

This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set on the phone with the new-tenants utility desk.

You will hear: giving your address and lease start date to open service; using a payment history from home to wave goodbye to the deposit; paper vs online bills, and the auto-pay trick that shaves a dollar a month; the free same-day fix if the lights stay dark; plus how canceling works and why you save the emergency line right away.

Everything stays at A2 level, ten words or fewer per line, with the fillers Americans use on real service calls: um, well, so, ha. By the end you'll own lines like I'm calling to turn on power, Is there a deposit? and Cancel anytime.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
搬家只剩九天，新家的水龍頭還在睡覺，燈開關還是黑的。押金要不要繳？能不能免？自動扣款真的會省錢嗎？

這一集帶大家撥一通新住戶專線，從報地址、租約日期開始，一路聽到免押金的祕訣、賬單格式、水閥檢查、急修專線與停用規則，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🔌 開場句：Hi, I'm calling to turn on power and water.
💰 押金句：Uh, is there a deposit? My budget whispers no.
✅ 免押句：Actually, a pay history waives it, ever paid bills?
📱 存號句：Emergency line, save it now, before you forget.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著娜迪雅打完這通電話，下次自己開通水電時，每一步都聽得懂。

祝你的第一個新家之夜，燈亮、水熱、心情穩。
